586-678-3967.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

3220-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5223-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2586-3197-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat

1339-1832-5231-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-5931.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

792-2292-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-2292-2946-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-7372-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
Summon: Good King Mog XII's second or third chapter abilities have triggered this turn. You control a non-Saga creature token.
1636-7372-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Summon: Good King Mog XII triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-3188-3490-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3188-3490-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

813-2104-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and exiling Ephemerate.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-2961-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2713-3094-4659-4927-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-4927-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4766-6730-7091.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {1}.
When Sin dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Sin and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4050-4766-6730-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Sin or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Sin with the returned creature for that iteration.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3499-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7160.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1978-3053-3088.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-3088.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

394-2034-2557-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-2557-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2466-4311-5051-5078.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1365-2608-6582-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2608-6582-6798.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

478-3573-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
478-3573-4331.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Candelabra of Tawnos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2073-4694--23.notablePrerequisites: Salvaging Station does not have summoning sickness.
2073-4694--23.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it returning the {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The artifact enters the battlefield as a creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Salvaging Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1251-1445-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1251-1445-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

969-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
969-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

222-2018-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1844-4691-5919.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least nine.
1844-4691-5919.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw eight cards and give control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

2366-2757-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-2757-4772-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
2366-2757-4772-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

215-729-2404-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Forensic Researcher does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2404-5475.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Forensic Researcher's first ability by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Forensic Researcher any number of times.

1458-3338-5034.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Mirran Spy.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mirran Spy by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

231-661-2419-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Treasure Vault.
Activate Sculpting Steel by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Sculpting Steel from the battlefield to your hand.
If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1893-2034-4404-5261.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Shallow Grave without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Shallow Grave, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
